title: Remote install and Pod disk - one umbrella over six cards that share routes/remote*.js
description: Cluster found by the mpi-end-session consolidation sweep: MPI-510, MPI-509, MPI-496, MPI-489, MPI-485, MPI-403 all touch the remote install path or the Pod's disk. They fail in the same place for the same reason and reading them one at a time hides that.
